decision: Quyen cua luot tao va luot submit la LOI KHAI cua client; may chu va agent khong bao gio NANG quyen tu hinh dang tin nhan (duong B+).
impact: Loai phuong an A (tach diem vao, bo commandType khoi input tRPC) va C (cam nang quyen giua hoi thoai). Tiet kiem: khong dong contract tRPC, khong dong client, khong dong src/generated/server.ts, khong dap luong go 'build me an agent' giua chat. Rui ro nhan vao: quyen luot dau van khong co gi phia may chu doi chung — mot nguoi da dang nhap tu khai CREATE_AGENT thi duoc; chap nhan duoc vi bien duyet cua nguoi la luc deploy, va ke cong nay chan la mo hinh chu khong phai trinh duyet.

decision: San dan so doi MENH DE: thay 'dem cho suy quyen tren ca kho = 0' bang bat bien NGUON GHI — moi commandType ghi vao Prisma data trong apps/api/src lay tu dung hai nguon da dat ten.
impact: Loai phuong an giu menh de cu roi chi nang bo do len AST va mo rong dan so sang apps/app. Tiet kiem: khong phai chung minh mot phu dinh tren ca kho — hinh dang bai toan khong bao gio do du. Rui ro nhan vao: san fail-closed se do khi co mot nguon hop le thu ba, nen ai them mot duong ghi hop le phai sua danh sach nguon.

decision: Bo ham dong nhat builderCommandType(commandType, message) va bo tham so message khoi builderSessionAttributes.
impact: Loai phuong an giu ham cho tuong thich. Doi lai loi hua 'agent khong suy quyen tu tin nhan' dung theo CAU TRUC chu khong chi theo mot phep do. Dong luon gioi han da ghi o vong cham 7 cua chan-uy-thac-sai-luot.

decision: Khong viet lai chu cua AC-5 va E5 trong ho so quyen-luot-mang-theo; chi phu mot dong gioi han da biet vao ## Notes.
impact: Tiet kiem: bang chung da ghim verified_commit cua vong do van noi ve dung loi hua no da cham. Rui ro nhan vao: ai doc ho so cu se thay mot loi hua rong hon su that, va phai doc them mot dong Notes moi biet no da bi thay.

decision: bo dac-ta-UX — vong nay khong cham surface web-UI nao: chi apps/agent, apps/api (doc), docs va _acceptance.
impact: cau truc khong khai truoc — owner thay no lan dau trong code

decision: Khong them phep do tich hop cham co so du lieu that cho respondToQuestion.
impact: Tiet kiem: khong can crm_<id>_test cho vong nay, bon phep do chinh chay nhanh trong bun run test san co. Rui ro nhan vao: duong GHI cua respondToQuestion chi duoc chung minh o muc ham thuan va o muc AST nguon ghi, khong o muc hang da luu.
revisit: Khi co mot lo lien quan den chinh duong ghi (khong phai gia tri ham tra ve), nang len phep do tich hop.

decision: Giu tier T2 theo dung luat suy tu duong dan, khong tu nang len T3 du viec nay la chuoi quyen.
impact: Tiet kiem: khong them mot cong duyet ke hoach. Rui ro nhan vao: apps/api/src/conversations/** khong nam trong t3_paths cua _acceptance/config.yaml, nen mot vong SAU nay co sua chuoi quyen o do se di duong T2. Bang tier co the dang thieu mot dong.
revisit: Nguoi ky quyet o Cong 1: co them apps/api/src/conversations/** vao t3_paths khong. Neu co thi mo chip rieng, khong sua trong vong nay.

decision: Tach mot ham san pham moi builderSessionAuthFromRow(hang, conversationId) o custom-agent-dispatch.ts, va do AC-1 qua ham do thay vi qua builderSessionAttributes.
impact: Loai phuong an de E1 nap thang khoi tham so — do chinh la fixture viet tay dung khuon ben doc, va cho ma RUT truong tu hang se nam ngoai duong do. Doi lai: them mot ham san pham chi de mot dau noi tro nen do duoc; chap nhan vi chinh dau noi ay la cho mot suy dien moi se moc.

decision: Them AC-9 doi bon lenh may cua ho so quen-luot-mang-theo con thoat 0, thay vi chua expected da ghim cua E5 cu.
impact: Loai phuong an chua E5 cu (bi descope d-20260909T143334Z-20735 cam) va phuong an xoa khoi describe suy-dien (lam lenh cu that bai). Doi lai: expected da ghim cua E5 cu se khong con mo ta thu lenh cua no chay — mot lech co that, nen AC-8 buoc dong Notes phai noi thang dieu do ra.

decision: San nguon ghi (AC-3) ghim danh sach theo khoa BEN `tep :: ham bao :: nguon` thay vi `file:dong` nhu chu cua AC-3, va VAN in file:dong trong thong diep do.
impact: Loai cach ghim theo so dong. Tiet kiem: khong bien san thanh may phat do-oan — sua bat ky dong nao phia tren trong conversations.service.ts se lam thuoc do du chuoi quyen khong doi, dung thu chinh AC-3 cam. Rui ro nhan vao: day la mot cho ke hoach LECH CHU cua hop dong da duyet, nen phai hien trong goi Cong 2 cho nguoi ky doc.

decision: Chay Task 5 va Task 8 TUAN TU trong main loop thay vi fan-out qua execute-parallel, du ca hai deu danh dau independent: true.
impact: Loai duong fan-out. Ly do do duoc: worktree do workflow dung khong co node_modules va khong co packages/db/src/generated, ma rang nguon-ghi.mjs import typescript tu node_modules. Chinh phien nay da vap dung cho do — prisma generate chet vi thieu .env, phai symlink .env tu checkout chinh. Doi lai: mat song song cua hai task nho.

decision: Bo khung dung node_modules cua tung goi thanh THU MUC THAT trong cay sao, voi scope @crm tro vao packages/* CUA CAY SAO; va noi them packages/*/src/generated.
impact: Loai cach symlink nguyen thu muc node_modules. Ly do: link @crm/* ben trong no la link TUONG DOI tro ve packages/* cua cay GOC, nen moi dot bien vao packages/** vo hinh — rang mang-theo-do ra XANH tren mot dot bien that. Do la dung lop loi vong nay di dong: mot phep do in ra mau ve MOT CAY KHAC cay no tuong. Doi lai: dung cay sao ton them mot vong lap symlink.

decision: San ma tran toan phan cua E4 bat duoc ten ham bao that la answerBuilderQuestion, khong phai respondToQuestion nhu S1 ghi. Sua design doc; KHONG sua contract.md va evals.yaml vi hai file do da duyet o Cong 1.
impact: Ten sai con o hai cho khong-quy-pham cua ho so da duyet: contract.md dong 63 (mot dong Later cua Coverage) va evals.yaml dong 206 (cau expected cua E7). Khong doi pham vi, khong doi thu gi duoc do — E7 cham docs/agent.md chu khong cham ten ham. Nhung nguoi ky can biet, nen no phai hien trong goi Cong 2. Ghi chu: mot can duoi >=3 se KHONG BAO GIO bat duoc loi nay; chinh ma tran toan phan bat.

decision: Script E10 doi tu `if ! bun test ...; then ma=$?` sang bat ma thoat truc tiep roi moi kiem.
impact: Chieu do bat duoc mot FAIL-OPEN trong chinh phep do: trong nhanh cua `if !`, $? la ma cua phep phu dinh (0), nen lenh hong ma script van thoat 0. Neu chi khai chieu do trong expected ma khong chay that thi loi nay di thang xuong Cong 2 duoi mau xanh.

decision: Ban khai sinh doc chu cua E8 LONG hon chu da duyet, o ba cho.
impact: (1) Dong E4 · duoi-select khai ma 0 trong khi expected cua E8 noi `ma` la so mong doi KHAC 0 — no la dong doi chung duong, khong phai vecto do. (2) Bo dem vecto tim `vecto "<ten>"` o BAT KY dau trong expected sau khi bo cac doan trong dau ngoac ma, trong khi E8 noi la mot dong BAT DAU bang chuoi do — E6 va E9 khai vecto cua chung giua cau (Doi chung duong, vecto "..."), doc dung chu se dem ra 0. (3) E8 tu khai 0 vecto nen khong co dong nao trong khai-sinh.json cho no; chieu do cua chinh E8 (--vecto khai-thieu-vecto) chay tay va ghi vao transcript, cung loi nhu E10. Ba cho nay phai hien trong goi Cong 2: chu cua evals.yaml duoc viet TRUOC khi rang ton tai.

decision: Xoa hai assertion goi builderCommandType trong apps/agent/test/custom-agent-runtime.spec.ts, va bo truong message khoi ba loi goi builderSessionAttributes trong ba bai test khac.
impact: Cong `bun run test` bat duoc ba ho tieu dung con lai ma Task 2 bo sot — check-types khong bat vi turbo dang tra loi tu cache. Hai assertion bi xoa tung khang dinh: mot message co inputResponse voi commandType CHAT thi van la CHAT. Dieu do NAY duoc do manh hon o quyen-luot.spec.ts khoi suy-dien, di TRON duong san pham thay vi goi mot ham dong nhat. Doi lai: neu ai doc lich su se thay hai assertion bien mat va can biet chung da chuyen di dau.

decision: Vong sua sau REJECT r1: (1) ba ma thoat tach bach — 0 xanh, 2 bat bien bi vi pham, 3 gian do hong; chayRang bat MOI ngoai le va tra 3; (2) khoa hoa thao tac git worktree de cac eval chay song song khong dam nhau, bo `worktree prune` toan cuc; (3) chay() khong con nuot loi spawn; (4) E2/E5 co che do tran chay het vecto, va chieu do phai neu TEN BAI TEST dung phai do — thoi tu in chuoi ghim o nhanh thanh cong; (5) E4 so danh sach CO BOI (bo Set) nen mot cho ghi thu hai trong cung ham khong con vo hinh.
impact: Nguyen nhan goc cua E8 do: cong-quyen-do.mjs chet bang mot ngoai le chua bat, Node thoat 1 — TRUNG dung ma da khai cho «dot bien bi giet» — nen chi phep kiem chuoi ghim cuu. Ma 3 rieng cho gian do hong lam ca lop lech nay khong con lot duoc. Khong sua cac muc triage khai inContract:false; chung di Cong 2.
